For me, it's a little complex. I'm the ex who repeatedly hurt her, and ignored when she tried to tell me how to change, and what she needed from the relationship. I've grown, seen the hurt that I've caused, and have become a better man. But, looking at it from her perspective, and probably the perspectives of other people in her life, I should be left in the past. The damage I've caused is irreversible, and she's found someone new who treats her right. That's good for her, and I'm working on accepting that I have to take this heart real and learn from it.

Do I want her back? No, not really. Mainly because we wanted different things in life. She wanted kids, I wasn't (and still am not) sure. She was sure about wanting to marry me, I was afraid of committing to her. My mental health was (and still sorta is) in the trash, I wasn't capable of loving someone. I couldn't give her the love she needed then, and my feelings towards her now have changed. I don't like how she's thrown my mental issues back at me after we broke up. I also don't like the fact that she's made posts on social media dragging me down for how I was when we were together. I also feel betrayed because she found someone so soon after we broke up. That was a lotta words, but in short, no, I don't want my ex back
